inspiration: Cone-shaped area effects: SpellCone.sql pairs spell ids with one shape value (line 38 shows the table form only). The idea is a fan-shaped sweep defined as data, which gives a readable telegraph for breath or sweeping attacks. Recreate with our own shape rules and numbers.

Encounters as a table: DungeonEncounter.sql (line 60) keeps boss encounters as rows of ids and flags rather than hand-written scripts. Recreate boss phases as a readable phase table that designers can edit.

Conditions as reusable rules: CombatCondition.sql (line 24) gates effects on self, target, friend and enemy conditions with logic fields, and UnitCondition.sql does the same per unit. A small rule table can gate our abilities without new code.

Pre-baked navigation per zone: contrib/mmap (with mmap_extract.py, name only read) and the dep/recastnavigation library suggest navmeshes built offline from map data so monsters path cheaply at run time. A pipeline idea for our zones; the actual mapping was not read.

Companion bots limited to learned skills: README_PLAYERBOT.txt line 8 says bots only use abilities the character has learned. A companion AI that is bounded by a skill tree, not by a cheat list, is a good design rule for our allies.

A market that moves on its own: doc/AuctionHouseBot.txt line 1 describes a bot that fills auction houses with items, so the economy feels active when players are few. Recreate as an NPC merchant that restocks on a timer.

briefs.label: Fan-cut breath
briefs.why: A fan-shaped sweep is easy to read and easy to dodge, so it works as a telegraphed hazard.
briefs.keep: Shape defined by a cone angle and a length as data; a short wind-up that shows the cone.
briefs.change: A curved arc with a telegraph ring; our own angle and length rules; a cooldown that ties into the creature's stance.

briefs.label: Phased guardian encounter
briefs.why: Readable phases make a boss feel like it changes shape and tactics, without a long script.
briefs.keep: Encounter phases as a table; each phase changes the attack set.
briefs.change: Phases tied to the arena (a surface that breaks, a light that moves); our own phase names and count.

briefs.label: Learned-skills companion
briefs.why: An ally that only uses what the player has trained keeps companions honest and easy to balance.
briefs.keep: The ally's kit is bounded by a learned skill set.
briefs.change: The ally has its own tree and a visible skill bar; the player teaches it moves in the field.
